geometry: Original authored native curves plus voxel-unioned original ellipsoid nodules and sealed rounded membrane. No generated 3D model or third-party mesh vertices imported.
reference_role: Independent local Krea images guide vascular taper, unequal lobes and membrane morphology. Architecture/lights/clearance invented by images were not used.
local_3d_study: H-017 evaluated CL3D/2mini externally. It was held from game import at provenance review; this native geometry does not use its output vertices. The model study and its license-review receipt remain outside this repository.
materials: Existing local Krea fibrous tissue albedo/normal/roughness. Only two stair-room material copies use the existing roughness map; slightly wetter nodule copy. All other roots/stone retain their existing material.
